Quilled Crochet Pattern Tester Call for a Dragonfly Please read the requirements all the way through if you are interested 🌻 This is a very simple pattern that uses only basic crochet stitches worked in rows, so beginners are welcome to test. All testing has to be completed by October 2nd and I will send the PDF pattern out via email on the 18th to all the selected testers. (2 weeks to complete). This pattern will work with any yarn weight and hook size (like amigurumi), I used worsted (big twist) with a 5.5mm hook. Feel free to use any colors and yarn weight you like :)  To be considered for testing: ⁣⁣ 1. Must be able to complete by Oct 2nd 2. Have a public account  3. Send me pictures of your final product by email or DM 4. Give detailed feedback on the pattern such as how I could make the pattern clearer, improve wording, etc.  5. Follow me ⁣⁣6. DM me that you are interested  7. Comment on this post  your favorite bug * Silly I know, but it's a way to know you have read all the requirements🌻 Thank you! And happy crocheting!!! 🌱🧶 #crochetpatterntesterswanted #patterntestingcall #crochettesterswanted #crochettestercall #crochet
